summary.text: In 2014 Hedy Lamarr was inducted into the National Inventors Hall of Fame.

sentences.text: The naturalization file at the National Archives at Riverside for Hedwig Maria Stauffer contains a certificate of arrival, declaration of intention, affidavits of witnesses, and petition for naturalization.
The 1940 motion picture poster for the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer picture Boom Town shows Hedy Lamarr in scenes from the movie.
The 1941 poster for the Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer film Ziegfeld Girl shows Hedy Lamarr.
The inventors of Patent Case File No. 2,292,387, Secret Communication System, were Hedy Kiesler Markey and George Antheil.
EVERYBODY JOINS U.S. WAR EFFORT [ETC.] (1942) has film entertainers on war bond tours, including Heddy Lamar.
The Army Hour of March 5, 1954, has a Command Performance comedy sequence from Hollywood, California, with Milton Berle, Hedy Lamarr and Edward G. Robinson.
The Radio Scripts files for the broadcast Command Performance contain studio photographs of program participants, including Hedy Lamarr.
